purpose: Determine whether a finite set of bond, convertible-bond, ETF, option and financing cross-asset concepts has a locally accepted historical point-in-time source contract and an issuer-level cross-sectional mapping before any factor is defined.

library_and_local_source_inventory.inventory_scope: repository definition names, already published contracts and local file paths only
library_and_local_source_inventory.interpretation: A concept without an accepted source contract is deferred rather than declared predictively ineffective; filenames or package method guesses are not source contracts.

finite_prevalue_source_catalog.name: outstanding_convertible_bond_equity_parity_premium_compression
finite_prevalue_source_catalog.economic_hypothesis: A close-known contraction in an issuer's outstanding convertible-bond premium to equity parity may reveal cross-market confirmation of near-term equity demand or credit risk.
finite_prevalue_source_catalog.reason: The repository contains no accepted historical contract jointly proving outstanding bond terms, clean bond prices, conversion-price adjustments, suspension/default states, publication timestamps and issuer-equity mapping. Campaign127's failed issuance source cannot be sampled or repurposed to choose this factor.

finite_prevalue_source_catalog.name: issuer_bond_credit_spread_equity_divergence
finite_prevalue_source_catalog.economic_hypothesis: A close-known widening in an issuer bond's credit spread while equity remains firm may identify an unresolved cross-market risk divergence over the next three sessions.
finite_prevalue_source_catalog.reason: No accepted local source defines executable clean yields, benchmark-curve matching, stale-price handling, defaults, multiple-bond aggregation, issuer-to-equity mapping and the denominator of issuers without bonds. Reading sparse observed bonds first would select the source on realized coverage.

finite_prevalue_source_catalog.name: etf_primary_market_creation_redemption_constituent_pressure
finite_prevalue_source_catalog.economic_hypothesis: Close-known ETF net creation pressure allocated through point-in-time constituent weights may transmit mechanical demand to constituent equities.
finite_prevalue_source_catalog.reason: The local source inventory has no accepted creation/redemption series, historical basket weights, effective-time rules or overlap policy for stocks held by multiple ETFs. Exchange volume is not primary-market net creation and cannot be substituted.

finite_prevalue_source_catalog.name: equity_option_implied_skew_or_term_structure_mapped_to_issuer
finite_prevalue_source_catalog.economic_hypothesis: A close-known option-implied downside skew or term slope could supply forward-looking risk information distinct from realized minute volatility.
finite_prevalue_source_catalog.reason: The repository has no accepted issuer-level option surface, quotes, open-interest quality, contract-adjustment history or mapping that covers the eligible A-share cross-section. Index/ETF option states are common or basket-level and cannot be attributed to constituents after observing outcomes.

finite_prevalue_source_catalog.name: margin_financing_minus_securities_lending_pressure_imbalance
finite_prevalue_source_catalog.economic_hypothesis: A high close-known financing-flow versus securities-lending pressure balance might represent net leveraged demand.
finite_prevalue_source_catalog.reason: Margin-financing mechanisms are terminal and the official securities-lending source failed before a full accepted snapshot. Subtracting, ratioing or ranking the two after those outcomes is a cross-source rescue, while missing lending observations cannot be imputed as zero.

finite_prevalue_source_catalog.name: index_futures_basis_times_stock_intraday_beta
finite_prevalue_source_catalog.economic_hypothesis: A stock's fitted exposure to a close-known index-futures basis shock might differentiate cross-sectional sensitivity to market funding pressure.
finite_prevalue_source_catalog.reason: Futures basis is common within a signal session and becomes cross-sectionally rankable only after fitting or multiplying a stock exposure. Market beta, residual, sign, response-delay and model-combination families are terminal; this is a cross-asset relabeling of that exposed interaction.

selection.reason: None of the six concepts simultaneously has an accepted point-in-time cross-asset source, stable issuer mapping, full-universe denominator, cross-sectional rankability and terminal-family independence.

future_revisit_rule.requirements: A later campaign must freeze exact official source identity, instrument and issuer mapping, timestamp semantics, corporate-action handling, stale quote rules, universe denominator, pagination, costs and acceptance gates before any source row or response value is observed.
